headline_marked: SpaceXAI launches [[Grok 4.5]] with enhanced coding and agentic tasks
headline: SpaceXAI launches Grok 4.5 with enhanced coding and agentic tasks
summary: The new Grok 4.5 model boasts superior performance in coding, knowledge work, and agentic tasks, outperforming leading models in benchmarks.
details: SpaceXAI has unveiled Grok 4.5, its most advanced model to date, specifically engineered for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. Trained on extensive datasets covering coding, science, engineering, and math, Grok 4.5 demonstrates intelligent and efficient reasoning, excelling in real-world engineering applications.

The model achieved the top score on Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark, showcasing its versatility beyond technical tasks. Grok 4.5 was trained on tens of thousands of NVIDIA GB300 GPUs, with a strong emphasis on data filtering and curation to ensure high-quality, relevant training data.

Grok 4.5 excels in complex coding scenarios, from intricate Rust and C/C++ tasks to building complete applications from a single prompt. It is capable of generating well-designed, end-to-end functional apps with minimal specification, demonstrating its robust development capabilities.

Serving at 80 TPS (tokens per second), Grok 4.5 offers twice the token efficiency of comparable leading models. This translates to faster results and significantly lower costs for users, providing high intelligence per unit of time and expense.

Grok 4.5 is now the default model in Grok Build and is available in Cursor and via the SpaceXAI console. It can also build complex Excel models, create native PowerPoint diagrams, and write clear prose in Word, integrating seamlessly into office productivity suites.

The model is priced competitively at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. Its enhanced token efficiency means it solves tasks in fewer steps, delivering superior intelligence and cost-effectiveness compared to other leading models.

Grok 4.5 is available starting today in Grok Build and Cursor, with limited-time free usage offers. Users can access it via an API key from the SpaceXAI console, with EU availability expected in mid-July.

headline_marked: Cognition Launches [[SWE-1.7]], Reaching Near GPT 5.5 Intelligence
headline: Cognition Launches SWE-1.7, Reaching Near GPT 5.5 Intelligence
summary: The new SWE-1.7 model, built on Kimi K2.7, demonstrates frontier-level intelligence at a significantly reduced cost and is now available in Devin.
details: Cognition has unveiled SWE-1.7, their most capable AI model to date, which rivals intelligence levels near GPT 5.5 and Opus. This advancement is attributed to broad improvements in their Reinforcement Learning (RL) pipeline, including enhanced infrastructure, more stable training, higher-quality data, and new techniques for long-horizon tasks.

Built upon a Kimi K2.7 base that had already undergone extensive RL post-training, SWE-1.7's substantial gains challenge the notion of a 'post-training ceiling.' This suggests that RL methods can push AI capabilities much further than previously anticipated, particularly for complex, long-horizon tasks crucial in software engineering.

The model is optimized for longer-horizon asynchronous tasks, a key component in producing high-quality software. Cognition has been refining principles for agentic software engineering, which are reflected in SWE-1.7's performance and behavior.
SWE-1.7 is accessible today within Devin, available via Web, Desktop, and CLI interfaces, processing at 1000 TPS. Cognition encourages users to experience its capabilities firsthand.

The training process for SWE-1.7 focused on stability and overcoming challenges like KL divergence mismatch between inference and training. Interventions such as top-p sampling, combined with sampling distribution replay, were crucial for maintaining training stability and preventing entropy collapse.
